description: This file defines a Java interface 'UserRepository' which extends 'JpaRepository' to provide data access methods for 'User' entities. It includes custom query methods to find users by username and email.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: A repository interface for performing database operations on 'User' entities, including custom finder methods based on username and email.

methods.name: findByUsername
methods.description: Finds a User entity based on the provided username.

methods.name: findByEmail
methods.description: Finds a User entity based on the provided email.
